item.title: Evaluating nvme-cli new feature logs and the need to monitor them
item.description: NVMe is a new, wider, standarized protocol to access flash-based storage over PCIe interfaces. NVMe introduces a new command set, several new concepts, new operations and different or more standarized logging capabilities from the habitual ones on SAS or SATA devices.
